title: Studio: a valueDomain control for text fields in the Object Field inspector — the consumer half of objectstack#14168
body:
Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` PM seat (session `session_0174WZTU6XcFcS7g2kykC53i`, seat post objectstack#6017) at 2026-09-04T04:09Z as the **consumer-side control** for the maintainer's ruling A on objectstack#14168: `FieldSchema` now carries `valueDomain` — `iana_time_zone` · `iso_4217_currency` · `iso_3166_alpha2` — authorable on `text` fields only, to be refused on the write path with `value_domain` once the engine half lands (an objectstack `domain:engine` card filed alongside). Spec half landed in objectstack PR #15133 (merge `1d7e76a6`, 04:05Z). `domain:*` is triage's to set (the fix lands in the published `@object-ui/app-shell` designer, so `domain:ui` is the seat's reading).

## Measured (by the objectstack#14168 dev, read-and-report; objectui `origin/main` `77b3cf1f` re-read by the seat at 04:06Z)

- The Object Field inspector is a hand-written key list: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` renders `scale` / `min` / `max` as explicit `InspectorNumberField` rows (`:622-641`) and the texty block starts at `:643` — nothing reads `FieldSchema`'s keys generically, so the new key does not appear on its own.
- `SchemaForm` is generic but excludes the Object/Field designers, so this is a designer edit, not a schema-driven one.

## The ask

A `valueDomain` select in the inspector's texty block, shown only when the field type is in the spec's `VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_TYPES` (today `text`), the three members labelled from the spec's `describe` prose, with an unset option that deletes the key (never writes `null`). The stored shape is the spec's: `valueDomain` set to one of `iana_time_zone` / `iso_4217_currency` / `iso_3166_alpha2` on the field def. The spec's authoring-form rows (`field.form.ts` / `object.form.ts`) land with the engine card; this inspector does not consume them.

## Unlock criterion

objectui consumes `@objectstack/spec` as a published package (`^17.0.0` on `origin/main`; 17.2.0 lacks the key): this card is actionable once a spec release carrying `FieldSchema.valueDomain` and the `@objectstack/spec/shared` value-domain exports (> 17.2.0) is installable here — not on the merge itself.
Restart-when: `pnpm view @objectstack/spec version` answers a version > 17.2.0 whose `dist` exports `isValueDomainMember` from the `shared` subpath (probe: `node -e "console.log(typeof require('@objectstack/spec/shared').isValueDomainMember)"` in a fresh install prints `function`)
